emote.name: GG
emote.desc: A happy dino says good game.

emote.name: Big Cry
emote.desc: A little blob cries its eyes out. Your Little Legend looks sad.

emote.name: Hi!
emote.desc: Say hello. Your Little Legend waves.

emote.name: My Dance
emote.desc: Your Little Legend does your equipped dance (pick it in the Locker).

emote.name: Fuming
emote.desc: Steam out of both ears. Your Little Legend taunts.

emote.name: Ha Ha
emote.desc: Laughing to tears. Your Little Legend cheers.

emote.name: Meat!
emote.desc: Snack time. Your Little Legend eats.

emote.name: Crowned
emote.desc: Top of the lobby. Your Little Legend cheers.

emote.name: Hop Dance
emote.desc: Dance: your Little Legend bounces on the spot.

emote.name: Wiggle Dance
emote.desc: Dance: your Little Legend wiggles side to side.

emote.name: Jijimon's Cane
emote.desc: Digimon World 1 emote. Retro: Jijimon shows up and waves his cane. Shows a 3D Digimon beside your Little Legend when used in a match.

emote.name: Frigimon Shiver
emote.desc: Digimon World 1 emote. Retro: Frigimon pops up shivering in a snow flurry. Shows a 3D Digimon beside your Little Legend when used in a match.

emote.name: Mamemon Flex
emote.desc: Digimon World 1 emote. Retro: Mamemon flexes beside your Little Legend. Shows a 3D Digimon beside your Little Legend when used in a match.

emote.name: Bakemon Float
emote.desc: Digimon World 1 emote. Retro: Bakemon floats up and sways. Shows a 3D Digimon beside your Little Legend when used in a match.

emote.name: Andromon Salute
emote.desc: Digimon World 1 emote. Retro: Andromon steps in and salutes. Shows a 3D Digimon beside your Little Legend when used in a match.

emote.name: Data Deleted
emote.desc: A glitching error screen. Your Little Legend taunts.

emote.name: Digivolve!
emote.desc: The device on the screen flashes.

emote.name: Crest Glow
emote.desc: A crest tag lights up. Your Little Legend cheers.

emote.name: Slide Dance
emote.desc: Dance: your Little Legend slides back and forth.

emote.name: Spin Dance
emote.desc: Dance: your Little Legend spins twice.

emote.name: Monzaemon Hug
emote.desc: Digimon World 1 emote. Retro: Monzaemon pops up, hugs your Little Legend and sends hearts. Shows a 3D Digimon beside your Little Legend when used in a match.

emote.name: Vademon UFO
emote.desc: Digimon World 1 emote. Retro: Vademon hovers over your Little Legend with a tractor beam. Shows a 3D Digimon beside your Little Legend when used in a match.

emote.name: Airdramon Swoop
emote.desc: Digimon World 1 emote. Retro: Airdramon swoops past your Little Legend. Shows a 3D Digimon beside your Little Legend when used in a match.

emote.name: Victory Flip
emote.desc: Dance: your Little Legend jumps and flips.

emote.name: Brachiomon Stomp
emote.desc: Digimon World 1 emote. Retro: Brachiomon stomps the ground beside your Little Legend. Shows a 3D Digimon beside your Little Legend when used in a match.

board.name: File Island
board.desc: Grass island in a dark sea, with pines, rocks and data crystals. The default board.

board.name: File Island Beach
board.desc: Sandy island in a turquoise sea. Palms sway, the surf rolls in, shells on the sand.

board.name: Server Desert
board.desc: Dunes under a hot sky. Cacti, sandstone and drifting sand, with heat haze on the horizon.

board.name: Primary Village
board.desc: Soft pastel meadow with cribs full of Digi-Eggs and toy blocks floating in the air.

board.name: Toy Town
board.desc: Block houses, candy poles, spinning tops and a toy train circling the island.

board.name: Ancient Coliseum
board.desc: Sand arena inside stepped stone seating at sunset, columns on the rim and banners on the wall.

board.name: Infinity Mountain
board.desc: Snowfield at night under the stars, snowy pines, falling snow and a tall peak in the distance.

board.name: Dark Ocean
board.desc: Black rock in a grey sea, thick fog, a broken pier and a lighthouse sweeping its beam.

board.name: Gear Savanna
board.desc: Golden grassland with flat-topped trees and huge brass gears turning half-buried in the ground.

board.name: Digital Grid
board.desc: Cyberspace: neon wireframe island on a glowing grid, floating polyhedra and falling data rain.

board.name: Spiral Mountain
board.desc: A shard of the Dark Masters' mountain hangs in a violet void. Rocks spiral around it, faster in combat, with purple lightning.

board.name: Myotismon's Castle
board.desc: Flagstone courtyard on a cliff, a blood moon rising behind the walls. Bats swarm when the fight starts and the moon reddens each stage.

board.name: Kowloon Overlay
board.desc: A rooftop in a neon city with a digital grid scanning over it. Neon signs flicker and the rain gets heavier when the fight starts.

board.name: Circuit Core
board.desc: The Digital World from inside a computer: the board is a giant chip on a circuit board, data pulses run the traces and code scrolls on the walls.

board.name: Zhuqiaomon's Temple
board.desc: A Sovereign's temple on a lava sea. Braziers roar, flame geysers burst, and the whole temple flares when your Digimon digivolve.

board.name: Gekomon Castle Depths
board.desc: A coral reef on the sea floor by ShogunGekomon's castle. Kelp sways, fish school around, bubbles rise and light ripples on the sand.

board.name: Freezeland
board.desc: An ice shelf on a frozen sea at twilight under the aurora. Calm between rounds; a blizzard blows in when the fight starts.

board.name: Numemon Sewer
board.desc: A tiled walkway over green sludge, home of the Numemon. They bob around, pipes drip, a rubber duck floats by, and they jump for joy when you win.

board.name: Witchelny Library
board.desc: A round hall of towering bookshelves. Books flap around, candles float and a magic circle turns under the board, flaring gold when your Digimon digivolve.

board.name: Royal Knights Coliseum
board.desc: A white marble arena at night with packed stands under floodlights. The crowd does the wave, jumps when the fight starts and goes wild when you win.

board.name: Ultimate Battle Arena
board.desc: A TV studio stage with sweeping spotlights, LED walls and a studio audience. The lights turn red and blue for the fight and confetti drops when you win.

board.name: Trailmon Station
board.desc: A concrete station platform in the evening. Trailmon rumbles past on the tracks behind the board, and always pulls through when a fight starts.

board.name: Overdell Cemetery
board.desc: A misty graveyard at dusk with crooked tombstones and Bakemon drifting about. In combat the fog thickens and green lightning cracks.

board.name: Server Pyramid
board.desc: The flat top of a great pyramid in the night desert. Glyph bands light up as the stages rise and the corner beams blaze when the fight starts.

board.name: File City
board.desc: Jijimon's village square. New buildings rise out of the ground each stage, from a few huts to a full town with a clock tower.

board.name: Holiday Digital World
board.desc: A snowy night square with a giant tree, presents, candy canes and gingerbread houses. The lights twinkle and burst gold when you win.

board.name: Gargomon Carnival
board.desc: A boardwalk carnival at dusk: a turning ferris wheel, a carousel, striped tents and balloons. Fireworks go up when you win.

board.name: Lantern Orchard
board.desc: A quiet daybreak retreat with moving garden landmarks.

board.desc: A quiet daybreak retreat with moving garden landmarks.
